moves.name:
Almighty Skies
Sacred Fire
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user’s HP is at 50% or more.
Deactivation Condition: When the user’s HP is less than 50%.

Never misses. Removes the frozen condition from the user. Leaves the target burned. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Makes the weather EX sunny if the remaining MP is 3 when this move is selected. Lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def by 3 stat ranks if the remaining MP is 2 when this move is selected. Applies the Enduring effect to all allied sync pairs if the remaining MP is 1 when this move is selected.

passives.name: Flame Myth
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]%.)

passives.description: Lowers the Attack and Sp. Atk of an opponent that attacked the user by [Digit:1digit ] stat [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ] when the user is hit by an attack move.
